title: Quantifying and Improving the Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Language Models Against Spurious Features in Grounding Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to semantic-agnostic 'spurious features' (like formatting or style). It does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
